name: Audit My Forms
author: yuktiadhikary

sections.description:
Audit My Forms is a tool for WordPress administrators and developers to audit forms used across their website. Over time, websites may accumulate forms from different plugins that are no longer in use, which can make management more difficult.

This plugin scans your site—including Pages, Posts, and Templates—to identify where forms are used and how they are configured.

Key Features:

  • Identify Unused Forms: Find forms that are not embedded on any page and may be candidates for removal.
  • Email Overview: View configured email addresses used for form submissions across supported plugins.
  • Builder Support: Works with Elementor and Divi templates and modules.
  • Multi-Plugin Support: Supports plugins such as WPForms, CF7, Fluent Forms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Forminator, Formidable, and MetForm.
  • Batch Scanning: Uses an AJAX-based process to handle scanning in steps and reduce server load.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via the WordPress ‘Add New’ screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to ‘Audit My Forms’ in your admin sidebar.
  4. Click ‘Run Scan’ to start the scan.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin safe for my database?

Yes. It is a read-only tool and does not modify or delete any form data or settings.

Will it find forms inside Elementor Templates?

Yes. It scans Elementor templates and detects forms used within them.

How long does the scan take?

The duration depends on the size of your site. The scan runs in batches to avoid timeouts on larger sites.
